# Extract the total score from the "score" column (e.g., "70 + 69 = 139" -> 139)
df['total'] = df['score'].str.extract(r'=\s*(\d+)').astype(int)

# Steve Stricker's score
stricker_score = df.loc[df['player'].str.lower() == 'steve stricker', 'total'].iloc[0]

# Check if he has the lowest score among all players
answer = bool(stricker_score == df['total'].min())
print(answer)
